summary: Two controllers (GasAnalysis, Movement) implement all 81 requirements; 7 review items flagged (invented defaults and design choices).

issues.title: Constant values are invented
issues.raw: Requirements CD-Const1..6 name thr, lv, evadeTime, stuckPeriod, stuckDist, outPeriod but give no values.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm or replace thr=3.0, lv=1.0, evadeTime=1, stuckPeriod=2, stuckDist=1.0, outPeriod=1 in DetectorConstants.

issues.title: analysis() and sensor-position-to-Angle mapping are invented
issues.raw: CD-Fn1 does not define when a reading "indicates" the target chemical; CD-DM7/CD-Fn3 do not define angle(x).
issues.fix_directive: analysis = gasD iff some value is for the target Chem with intensity > 0; angle(1..4) = Front, Right, Back, Left (mod 4). Confirm.

issues.title: Terminal modes keep one self-loop
issues.raw: CD-GA-Beh6 "concludes, processing no further readings"; CD-MV-Beh9 "stays halted". Neither says how later inputs are handled.
issues.fix_directive: GasAnalysis.Concluded consumes later gas events (stores gs, never classifies); Movement.Found consumes later obstacle events without moving. Every mode therefore has an outgoing transition.

issues.title: Operations realised as Vehicle methods, not compute() classes
issues.raw: CD-OP1..4 (move, randomWalk, shortRandomWalk, changeDirection) are actuations, not computations; no operation package was created.
issues.fix_directive: Vehicle.move/randomWalk/shortRandomWalk/changeDirection; changeDirection maps left->Right, right->Left, front->Back at lv.

issues.title: Odometer is a sensor read, not an input event
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 is typed "event" but only describes sampling the distance into d0/d1.
issues.fix_directive: d0/d1 = sensors.odometer() on the relevant transitions.

issues.title: Chem modelled as record(nat id); Intensity as real
issues.fix_directive: Chem(int id) with equality; intensity values are double with goreq as the comparison.

issues.title: Waiting during-action randomWalk()
issues.raw: CD-MV-FR1 specifies a during action; the Java controller calls vehicle.randomWalk() at the head of the Waiting block each cycle.
issues.fix_directive: No change unless the extracted model needs a different placement.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile, coverage, preflight, T2M, M2M, M2T, verifiers).
